description: This file defines the 'AnalyticsScreen' widget, a Flutter UI screen that displays user quiz analytics including KPIs, filters, and individual quiz performance details. It utilizes Riverpod for state management and Flutter Material widgets for UI layout.

classes.name: AnalyticsScreen
classes.description: A Flutter widget representing a screen that shows quiz analytics with KPIs, filters, and per-quiz breakdown. It reacts to data streams from providers and updates UI accordingly.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the widget tree for the analytics screen, reacting to various provider states for data, loading, or error states.

methods.name: _filterBar
methods.description: Creates a filter bar UI with category dropdown and date range picker for filtering analytics data.

methods.name: _isSameRange
methods.description: Checks if the current filter range matches a preset number of days.

methods.name: _presetChip
methods.description: Creates a choice chip UI for quick preset date ranges.

methods.name: _allChip
methods.description: Creates a chip for selecting the 'All' date range filter.

methods.name: _rangeLabel
methods.description: Formats the selected date range as a string.

methods.name: _kpiCard
methods.description: Builds a card widget displaying a KPI metric with icon and styling.

methods.name: _quizStatTile
methods.description: Displays detailed performance stats for a specific quiz.

methods.name: _miniBar
methods.description: Render a small bar indicating a score percentage with label.

methods.name: _pill
methods.description: Creates a badge-like widget with text and color styling.

methods.name: _emptyStateFiltered
methods.description: Displays a message and reset button when there is no data for the current filters.
